paired_uncertainty.method: calendar moving-block bootstrap, paired across variants

predeclared_evaluation.positive: At formal review after both minima: 95% CI upper bounds for both paired log-loss and Brier deltas are below zero; the frozen simulated combo account is profitable and exceeds market_only; the paired 95% CI for equal-stake hypothetical PnL per common eligible window is above zero. Result remains paper-only because actual fills and fees are unknown.
predeclared_evaluation.negative: At formal review after both minima: 95% CI lower bounds for both paired log-loss and Brier deltas are above zero, or the 95% CI upper bound for paired equal-stake hypothetical PnL per common eligible window is below zero.
predeclared_evaluation.inconclusive: Any other outcome. If fewer than 100 combo hypothetical trades at day 730, continue unchanged to day 1095; below 100 at the cap remains unresolved.
predeclared_evaluation.training_sample_warning: The 9,407-row development sample was used by the prior comparison and is not independent. No threshold, model, calibration, stake, or cost changes are allowed during this session.
predeclared_evaluation.power_projection: The prior 3-day-block LL interval implies an optimistic 80% power requirement of about 13,900 windows (~50 days at 9,407 windows/32.7 days); the observed combo fill rate implies about 655 days for 100 trades. The 730-day minimum is governed by trade count, not window count.
